caption: The drawing depicts a large, round plate shown from a top-down perspective, rendered in grayscale. The plate has a wide, slightly concave rim and a deeper central area. On the upper right inner rim, four small square hallmark symbols are visible, positioned in a horizontal sequence. In the center of the plate, there is a detailed illustration of a heraldic crest featuring various decorative elements including mantling, a shield, supporters, and a crest above the shield. Beneath the crest, there is an inscription in a serifed Latin script that reads: "HIEC ANULa seu LIANX HUIC ECCLESIÆ CONFERITUR," with ornamental flourishes above and below the text. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular frame, and the artist’s signature "H. Reina" appears in the lower right corner. The entire composition is done in pencil or graphite on light beige paper, with shading used to convey the plate’s metallic texture and three-dimensional form.
title: Silver Christening Bowl
